metadata.title: Signal 45
metadata.model_name: The First Count survival and spatial feasibility model
metadata.notes: This model tests internal consistency, survival causality, spatially calibrated schedule resilience, outcome classification, and save idempotency. It cannot prove fun, comprehension, camera comfort, emotional impact, forecast readability, build tactility, device performance, or measured runtime pacing.

swelter.label: Day Shift — Swelter
swelter.entry: Graymorn ledger accepted and day forecast visible
swelter.exit: Shelter work window closed or player advances after all severe incidents are stable
swelter.simulation: Runs at selected speed except during blocking choices
swelter.pause: Auto-pauses for serious health, structure, trapping, or severe cascade decisions
swelter.autosave: On entry, project transaction, stabilized incident stage, and exit

slack.label: Evening Window — Slack
slack.simulation: Routine shelter tasks may finish; blocking commitments pause
slack.pause: Signal, promise, loadout, and irreversible confirmations pause
slack.autosave: On signal commitment, loadout commitment, and exit

nightrun.label: Night Operation — Nightrun
nightrun.exit: Expedition returns, retreats, or no-run state commits
nightrun.simulation: Uses the same graph facts for active and delegated modes
nightrun.pause: Auto-pauses before every committed consequential node
nightrun.autosave: Before departure, node entry, irreversible node action, retreat, and return

graymorn.label: Return and Report — Graymorn
graymorn.exit: Inventory, treatment, consequences, and day ledger accepted
graymorn.simulation: Paused while ledger or blocking treatment decision is open
graymorn.pause: Always pauses for ledger and irreversible consequence confirmation
graymorn.autosave: Before ledger, after treatment transaction, and after ledger

condition_combination.method: dominant impairment plus capped secondary penalties

Food.reservation_behavior: packed rations reserve at expedition commitment
Food.storage_behavior: sealed dry stores share the Food capacity; a reservation remains visible but unavailable
Food.loss_behavior: no passive loss; spoilage only through a forecast incident
Food.forecast_formula: current minus committed meal and expedition issues plus confirmed gains at the next ledger
Food.critical_consequence: repeated shortage advances Hunger and eventually strains Health
Food.save_representation: decimal amount, capacity, reservations by transaction ID, and consecutive ration count
Food.slice_boundary: stored rations, issues, trade, expedition choice, and transparent emergency portions; no agriculture
Food.full_game_extension_boundary: preservation and specialized Food rooms may extend supply without adding another primary stock

Clean Water.player_interpretation: stored clean water ready to drink or use in care
Clean Water.reservation_behavior: treatment and packed water reserve by transaction ID
Clean Water.storage_behavior: only clean connected or isolated declared storage contributes to the stock
Clean Water.loss_behavior: only named leakage, contamination isolation, or storm impairment
Clean Water.forecast_formula: clean stock plus committed treated throughput minus resident, treatment, packed, and known incident issues
Clean Water.critical_consequence: safe issue or named treatment cannot continue
Clean Water.save_representation: decimal clean stock, reservations, storage isolation, contamination state, and failing link
Clean Water.slice_boundary: five-link Water utility and clean stock only; no individual pipes or fluid simulation
Clean Water.full_game_extension_boundary: additional sources, tanks, and treatment specializations extend the same five-link chain

Medicine.player_interpretation: general medical supplies consumed by named care
Medicine.reservation_behavior: reserved once when a named treatment starts
Medicine.storage_behavior: one top-level medical locker capacity; named treatment reservations are unavailable to other care
Medicine.loss_behavior: no passive expiration in The First Count
Medicine.forecast_formula: available Medicine minus active named-treatment reservations plus confirmed trader or expedition gains
Medicine.critical_consequence: a known serious condition cannot be stabilized
Medicine.save_representation: decimal amount plus treatment reservation and completion transaction IDs
Medicine.slice_boundary: one Medicine stock consumed only by named examination, stabilization, and treatment transactions
Medicine.full_game_extension_boundary: specific items may become detailed inventory without adding a sixth HUD stock

Materials.player_interpretation: mixed common construction and repair stock
Materials.reservation_behavior: reserved at project activation and consumed by committed stage
Materials.storage_behavior: common bundles share capacity; route-critical components remain separate named blockers
Materials.loss_behavior: cancellation and deconstruction return only the class-defined fraction
Materials.forecast_formula: available common bundles minus active project reservations and repair commitments plus confirmed salvage
emergency_responses: inferior substitution with declared later repair
Materials.critical_consequence: required repair or construction stage is blocked
Materials.save_representation: decimal common stock, per-project reservations, delivered stages, and component inventory
Materials.slice_boundary: common Materials plus five representative component families; no large crafting inventory
Materials.full_game_extension_boundary: more recipes consume detailed items behind the same Materials summary

Charge.player_interpretation: stored electrical reserve in the flywheel and cells
secondary_sources: no routine recharge during The First Count
Charge.reservation_behavior: discharge names one connected consumer and commits atomically
Charge.storage_behavior: flywheel and cells share capacity; stored reserve does not imply live Power connectivity
Charge.loss_behavior: ten percent conversion loss on delivered reserve
Charge.forecast_formula: stored reserve divided by named connected deficit and conversion loss, capped by per-stage discharge
emergency_responses: preserve one critical connected load for a forecast duration
Charge.critical_consequence: connected critical load cannot bridge the current Power deficit
Charge.save_representation: decimal reserve, named consumer, stage limit, loss, and discharge transaction IDs
Charge.slice_boundary: finite starting reserve with no routine recharge; Charge cannot repair or bridge a disconnected branch
Charge.full_game_extension_boundary: later recharge equipment extends the same reserve model without merging it with Power

outcome_classes.FULL_PROOF: Essential survival is viable, every mandatory slice proof completes, and Day 7 supports an ambitious future direction.
outcome_classes.RECOVER_FIRST: Essential survival is viable, but repair, treatment, or shortage makes the canonical Recover First direction the honest result.
outcome_classes.PROOF_INCOMPLETE: The shelter may remain alive, but a release-slice mechanic, route proof, tutorial, or acceptance condition was not demonstrated.
outcome_classes.SHELTER_FAILURE: Essential residents or systems cannot reach a recoverable Day 7 state.
outcome_classes.INVARIANT_ERROR: The simulation entered an impossible, duplicated, malformed, negative, or save-divergent state.

forecast_framework.false_precision_rule: Estimates, signal intelligence, and unknowns use ranges or plain-language horizons rather than invented decimals.

health.critical_restriction: critical gives zero productive work and requires care
health.recovery: named treatment plus observation or rest
health.ui: one primary meter plus named contextual cause

hunger.critical_restriction: prolonged shortage reduces work and may strain Health after warning
hunger.recovery: normal meals over later issue boundaries
hunger.ui: one primary meter with meal consequence text

fatigue.critical_restriction: collapse risk gives zero ordinary assignment
fatigue.recovery: protected rest block and promise repayment
fatigue.ui: one primary meter with next-rest forecast

stress.critical_restriction: acute pressure limits work but does not alone create medical incapacity
stress.recovery: safety, rest, kept promises, preferred recovery behavior
stress.ui: one primary meter with specific source labels

respiratory_exposure.cause: cinder exposure or degraded Air in an occupied section
respiratory_exposure.warning: coughing, exposure icon, and Air-stage forecast before serious impairment
respiratory_exposure.possible_lasting_effect: temporary respiratory sensitivity after sustained neglect

minor_injury.cause: visible accepted construction risk or another forecast physical hazard
minor_injury.warning: hazard card names protection, warning, stabilization, and likely injury
minor_injury.possible_lasting_effect: none in the slice when treated

serious_injury.cause: multiple visible risks knowingly accepted or a severe warned incident
serious_injury.warning: critical hazard confirmation and response clock

critical.progression_if_delayed: slice remains recoverable only through immediate stabilization

exhaustion.cause: Highball, broken rest, or sustained work at collapse risk
exhaustion.warning: Fatigue reaches exhausted before collapse risk
exhaustion.possible_lasting_effect: none after protected rest in the slice

waterborne_illness.cause: known contaminated or suspect Water used after warning
waterborne_illness.warning: Water overlay names treatment or clean-storage failure

relay_load_test.context: Relay Kiosk calibration before Forecast Board installation

swelter_heat.forecast_source: surface thermometers and civic heat bulletins
swelter_heat.audio: distant metal expansion and weak wind
swelter_heat.accessibility: heat icon plus plain-language surface closure

cinder_front.forecast_source: Listening Post burst plus filter readings
cinder_front.utility_effect: Air then Power then Water only
cinder_front.audio: fan strain and exterior cinder impact
cinder_front.accessibility: stage label, direction cue, auto-pause at severe transition

ash_wash_aftermath.utility_effect: one Water or storage warning, not a second major crisis
ash_wash_aftermath.expedition_effect: site access remains closed until next window
ash_wash_aftermath.visual: gray water marks and bagged filter media

ration_food.delayed_cost: Hunger and Stress escalate when repeated
ration_food.resource_impact: saves 0.25 Food per resident on a restricted issue

restrict_water.delayed_cost: contextual dehydration and Stress if repeated

shed_load.immediate_cost: named room or lamp shuts down

evacuate.abuse_prevention: evacuated residents cannot work in the closed section

defer_project.resource_impact: reservation remains or cancellation rules apply

temporary_room_conversion.immediate_benefit: creates treatment, rest, or storage capacity

highball_order.immediate_benefit: pulls project work before a deadline
highball_order.immediate_cost: Fatigue, Charge, wear, Stress, and strain
highball_order.abuse_prevention: strain tiers, medical eligibility, escalating repayment

power_instability.initial_warning: lights flicker and margin card turns negative

air_contamination.completion_condition: section returns to Loaded or better
air_contamination.failure_condition: extended Evacuate stage without safe destination

water_contamination.failure_condition: no clean issue or treatment source remains

structural_instability.trigger: storm or project load reaches Unstable
structural_instability.propagation_rule: at most one adjacent section warning
structural_instability.failure_condition: no safe path or recoverable essential utility

equipment_breakdown.propagation_rule: no propagation unless it is an essential utility source

medical_emergency.failure_condition: known serious condition cannot be stabilized

spatial_mapping.selection_reason: coordinate result replaces compact abstract allowance
coordinate result fits within the existing typical allowance; conservative 0.10 retained until damp-floor and congestion graybox measurement

storm.forecast_source: Listening Post weather burst corroborated by local filter readings

Air.cause: Cinder load is saturating the temporary filter
Air.next: Fan demand may exceed Power margin
Air.interruption: Service or replace the filter, seal the affected section, or evacuate it

Power.cause: Air filtration is drawing emergency Power
Power.effect: Power margin is negative and Charge or load shedding is active
Power.interruption: Shed Workshop/comfort load, discharge Charge, or reduce Air demand

Water.cause: The pump or treatment branch lost sufficient Power
Water.next: Stored Clean Water falls and respiratory/treatment pressure rises
Water.interruption: Isolate dirty intake, restore pump priority, or use stored reserve
